33657-cinderella-jane.title: Cinderella Jane
33657-cinderella-jane.creator: Marjorie Benton Cooke
33657-cinderella-jane.description: A book by Marjorie Benton Cooke. It was a season when all the society clubs and leagues were spending themselves and their money in lavish spectacles of all kinds. There were Balls of the Gods and Pagan Routs, Persian Ballets and Greek Friezes, personified by the very best people, and some of the second best.

arxiv-2101-05262.title: Natural hyperbolicity in the layered hexagonal crystal structure
arxiv-2101-05262.creator: Ali Ebrahimian, Reza Asgari
arxiv-2101-05262.description: Abstract Discovering the physical requirements for meeting the indefinite permittivity in natural material as well as proposing a new natural hyperbolic media offer a possible route to significantly improve our knowledge and ability to confine and controlling light in optoelectronic devices.

arxiv-2110-08726.title: Data Shapley Value for Handling Noisy Labels: An application in Screening COVID-19 Pneumonia from Chest CT Scans
arxiv-2110-08726.creator: Nastaran Enshaei, Moezedin Javad Rafiee, MD, Arash Mohammadi, Farnoosh Naderkhani
arxiv-2110-08726.description: Abstract A long-standing challenge of deep learning models involves how to handle noisy labels, especially in applications where human lives are at stake. Adoption of the data Shapley Value (SV), a cooperative game theoretical approach, is an intelligent valuation solution to tackle the issue of noisy labels.

arxiv-2310-17548.title: Information reconciliation for discretely-modulated continuous-variable quantum key distribution
arxiv-2310-17548.creator: Anthony Leverrier
arxiv-2310-17548.description: Abstract The goal of this note is to explain the reconciliation problem for continuous-variable quantum key distribution protocols with a discrete modulation. Such modulation formats are attractive since they significantly simplify experimental implementations compared to protocols with a Gaussian modulation.

arxiv-2405-20402.title: Cross-Talk Reduction
arxiv-2405-20402.creator: Zhong-Qiu Wang, Anurag Kumar, Shinji Watanabe
arxiv-2405-20402.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Zhong-Qiu Wang, Anurag Kumar, Shinji Watanabe. While far-field multi-talker mixtures are recorded, each speaker can wear a close-talk microphone so that close-talk mixtures can be recorded at the same time. Although each close-talk mixture has a high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of the wearer, it has a very limited range of applications, as it also contains significant cross-talk speech by other speakers and is not clean enough.

arxiv-2409-14672.title: Speechworthy Instruction-tuned Language Models
arxiv-2409-14672.creator: Hyundong Cho, Nicolaas Jedema, Leonardo F. R. Ribeiro, Karishma Sharma, Pedro Szekely, Alessandro Moschitti, Ruben Janssen,, Jonathan May
arxiv-2409-14672.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Hyundong Cho, Nicolaas Jedema, Leonardo F. R. Ribeiro, Karishma Sharma, Pedro Szekely, Alessandro Moschitti, Ruben Janssen,, Jonathan May. Current instruction-tuned language models are exclusively trained with textual preference data and thus are often not aligned with the unique requirements of other modalities, such as speech.

arxiv-2411-00696.title: CTPD : Cross-Modal Temporal Pattern Discovery for Enhanced Multimodal Electronic Health Records Analysis
arxiv-2411-00696.creator: Fuying Wang, Feng Wu, Yihan Tang, Lequan Yu
arxiv-2411-00696.description: Abstract Integrating multimodal Electronic Health Records (EHR) data—such as numerical time series and free-text clinical reports—has great potential in predicting clinical outcomes. However, prior work has primarily focused on capturing temporal interactions within individual samples and fusing multimodal information, overlooking critical temporal patterns across patients.

arxiv-2512-12190.title: Observational Properties of β \beta Cephei Stars: 88 new samples discovered Based on TESS and Gaia Data
arxiv-2512-12190.creator: Xiang-dong Shi, Sheng-bang Qian, Li-ying Zhu, Lin-jia Li, Er-gang Zhao, David Mkrtichian, Farkhodjon Khamrakulov, Wen-xu Lin
arxiv-2512-12190.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Xiang-dong Shi, Sheng-bang Qian, Li-ying Zhu, Lin-jia Li, Er-gang Zhao, David Mkrtichian, Farkhodjon Khamrakulov, Wen-xu Lin. We present a systematic investigation of β \beta Cephei (BCEP) stars by integrating photometric data from the Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS) with astrometric parameters from Gaia Data Release 3.

pmc-11516321.title: Long-term effects of arsenic on glucose-insulin homeostasis: A gene-environment interaction study
pmc-11516321.creator: Z Yongfang
pmc-11516321.description: BackgroundArsenic exposure and genetic factors are associated with an increased risk of type 2 diabetes, yet study of environment-gene interaction on glucose-insulin homeostasis remains scarce. We aimed to investigate the associations and interactions of urinary total arsenic (UTAs) and genetic susceptibility with glucose-insulin homeostasis through a longitudinal epidemiological study.

pmc-11638243.title: Silver nanoparticles loaded with pomegranate peel extract and hyaluronic acid mediate recovery of cutaneous wounds infected with Candida albicans
pmc-11638243.creator: Marwa I. Abd El-Hamid, Doaa Ibrahim, Ahmed Abdelfattah-Hassan, Osama B. Mohammed, Ioan Pet, Samah S. Khalil, Sara M. El-Badry, Aya Sh. Metwally, Asmaa A. Azouz, Ahmed A. Elnegiry, Shimaa S. Elnahriry, Mirela Ahmadi, Sara T. Elazab
pmc-11638243.description: Smart innovative nanocomposites based on active ingredients and metallic nanoparticles with effective wound healing and antifungal properties are efficient in overcoming the limitations of traditional therapeutic products. Open wounds provide an ideal niche for colonization by Candida albicans (C. albicans) which poses substantial global health issues owing to delayed wound healing and disordered healing mechanisms.

pmc-11862040.title: Acute Stress Induced Catatonic Psychosis in an Adolescent: A Case Report
pmc-11862040.creator: E Yerlikaya Oral
pmc-11862040.description: IntroductionChildhood maltreatment(CM) can precipitate a range of psychiatric disorders in individuals. Some research show that CM rates are as high as 85% in schizophrenia spectrum disorders (Larsson et al. 2013). This case report explores an instance of acute catatonic psychosis in an adolescent following a significant episode of physical and emotional abuse.

pmc-12412413.title: Safety and 1‐Year Outcomes After Transplanting Hearts From SARS‐CoV‐2 Positive Donors: Insights From an International Analysis
pmc-12412413.creator: Sabina P. W. Guenther, Josephine Wadewitz, Brian J. Wayda, Henrik Fox, Rayan Cheaban, Yasuhiro Shudo, William Hiesinger, Angelika Costard‐Jäckle, Michiel Morshuis, Y. Joseph Woo, Jeffrey J. Teuteberg, René Schramm, Axel Rahmel, Jan F. Gummert, Kiran K. Khush
pmc-12412413.description: BackgroundUncertainties persist regarding the utilization of hearts from SARS‐CoV‐2‐positive donors for heart transplant (HT). This international study analyzed such HTs within the United States (US) and Germany, focusing on 1‐year outcomes and granular safety data.MethodsData was obtained from the United Network for Organ Sharing (UNOS) registry (03/2021–08/2022) and collaborating with the German Organ Procurement Organisation (DSO; 03/2022–02/2023).

pmc-12468377.title: Elevated Mean Corpuscular Hemoglobin Concentration as a Potential Peripheral Biomarker of Parkinson’s Disease: A Pilot Case–Control Study in a Mexican Population
pmc-12468377.creator: Ernesto Gerardo Miranda-Morales, Elizabeth Romero-Gutierrez, Francisco Xavier Castellanos-Juárez, Edna Madai Méndez-Hernández, Alma Cristina Salas-Leal, Osmel La Llave-León, Gerardo Quiñones-Canales, Ada Sandoval-Carrillo, José Manuel Salas-Pacheco, Oscar Arias-Carrión
pmc-12468377.description: Background: Alterations in peripheral red blood cell (RBC) indices have been proposed as potential biomarkers for Parkinson’s disease (PD), but their diagnostic utility and relation to clinical features remain uncertain. Methods: We conducted a pilot case–control study involving 70 PD patients and 122 controls from two neurology centers in Mexico.

pmc-12521610.title: Forest Age and Soil Depth Mediate the Effects of Soil and Root Traits on Soil Microbial Community in Plantations
pmc-12521610.creator: Yaxuan Chen, Qianyuan Liu, Yanmei Chen, Changqi Ai, Peipei Jiang
pmc-12521610.description: The soil microbial community composition and Alpha diversity serve as key indicators of soil quality changes driven by forest development. We explored the variations in soil properties, root traits, microbial communities, and their interrelationships across forest age and soil depth in Populus tomentosa , Platycladus orientalis , and Styphnolobium japonicum plantations.

pmc-12772586.title: Distal-to-proximal progression of apophyseal injuries with age in male youth academy footballers: a two-season prospective cohort study of 16,024 player-seasons
pmc-12772586.creator: Chelsea Oxendale, Matthew Green, Keith Stokes, Sean Cumming, Gemma Nicole Parry, Sean Williams
pmc-12772586.description: ObjectivesYouth football players are vulnerable to apophyseal injuries, which can have long-term consequences for health and performance. The objective was to assess the incidence, severity and burden of apophyseal injuries among U9–U21 academy football players over two seasons.MethodsTime-loss injuries and match/training exposure were tracked in male academy football players (U9–U21) from Premier League and Category One Academies.

pmc-13092863.title: Targeting enhancing myelin regeneration reverses cognitive deficits in a mouse model of intellectual disability
pmc-13092863.creator: Pingping Qiao, He Wang, Pingping Qu, Lifang Guo, Yanbo Zhou, Tingting Zeng, Jiang Chen, Jian Li, Yimin Hu, Guiquan Chen
pmc-13092863.description: The early postnatal period is a critical window for brain maturation, during which oligodendrogenesis, myelination, and synaptogenesis are dynamically orchestrated to support cognitive development. Clinical studies have associated myelination deficits with intellectual disability (ID), but the molecular mechanisms linking myelin deficits to cognitive dysfunction remain poorly understood.

pmc-13158358.title: Semaglutide Reverses Ectopic Lipid Accumulation, Impaired Myocardial Perfusion Reserve, and Diastolic Dysfunction in a Mouse Model of Cardiometabolic Heart Disease
pmc-13158358.creator: Thomas P Skacel, Nemati R Saleh, Caitlin M Pavelec, Kenny Quach, Leigh A Bradley, Julia E Bresticker, Amit R Patel, Matthew J Wolf, Frederick H Epstein
pmc-13158358.description: Visual AbstractKey Words: coronary microvascular dysfunction, epicardial adipose tissue, GLP-1RA, HFpEF, obesity Obesity and the associated expansion of visceral adipose tissue (VAT) are central to the pathogenesis of cardiometabolic heart disease, and are increasingly recognized to underlie its progression to heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF).

pmc-13199924.title: Development of a discrete choice experiment—an instrument to weight the preferences of registered nursing undergraduates to future employers: a descriptive study
pmc-13199924.creator: Jana Bartakova, Martine Sophie Amrein, Diana Trutschel, Michael Simon
pmc-13199924.description: BackgroundHealthcare systems worldwide, including in Switzerland, struggle to retain nurses and make the profession appealing to young people. Studies identify factors influencing Swiss nurses' job attraction and retention, but these factors are often presented as simple lists without insights into their impact—a crucial aspect for making informed policy decisions.

pmc-13337311.title: Association between base excess levels and clinical outcomes among very low birth weight infants: a multicenter birth cohort study in South Korea
pmc-13337311.creator: Ji Yoo Kim, Hyeon Jin Kim, Heeyoon Choi, Minji Kim, Jinseok Lee, Yong Sung Choi, Dong Keon Yon
pmc-13337311.description: Background The impact of metabolic acidosis on short-term outcomes and mortality in very low birth weight infants (VLBWIs) has not been well studied.Purpose To investigate the potential association between metabolic acidosis and the clinical outcomes of VLBWIs in South Korea.

pmc-13374794.title: HelloType1 Digital Education Platform for Individuals With Type 1 Diabetes in Southeast Asia: Data Analytics Study
pmc-13374794.creator: Sze May Ng, Soe Nyi Nyi, Muhammad Yazid Jalaludin, Azriyanti Anuar Zaini, Phat Tung Ma, Sirimon Reutrakul, Taninee Sahakitrungruang, Sum Satha, Candy Gan, Darren Jia Chen Toh, Anne-Charlotte Ficheroulle, Luke MacNeill
pmc-13374794.description: BackgroundType 1 diabetes remains an underrecognized and challenging condition across Southeast Asia, where many countries face limited health care infrastructure, shortages of trained health care professionals, inconsistent access to diabetes education, and a lack of culturally appropriate resources in local languages. These barriers contribute to delayed diagnosis, suboptimal self-management, high rates of diabetic ketoacidosis, and inequities in care.

pmc-13507116.title: Evaluation of a novel C2 pedicle screw insertion technique: a retrospective comparative clinical study and finite element analysis
pmc-13507116.creator: Shuai Zhang, Guofeng Zhang, Jingyu Zhang, Yuancheng Zhang, Hua Wang, Jianru Wang, Guowei Han, Hui Liu, Zemin Li

pmc-13649854.title: Mesenteric defect closure versus non-closure after complete mesocolic excision in minimally invasive right colectomy: a retrospective study
pmc-13649854.creator: Arcangelo Picciariello, Vito Leonardo Pinto, Salvatore Fedele, Fabrizio Aquilino, Vincenzo Papagni, Leonardo Vincenti
pmc-13649854.description: BackgroundThe optimal management of the mesenteric defect after minimally invasive right hemicolectomy remains controversial, particularly in the setting of complete mesocolic excision (CME), where a large mesenteric defect is created. This study was aimed at evaluating whether mesenteric defect closure after CME reduces postoperative complications and whether the closure itself introduces additional risks.
